# Yippie

> Yippie is an AI powered customer service platform for small and medium businesses (SMBs), built in the Netherlands. It combines a shared inbox, tickets, contacts, live chat, bookings, pipeline, and marketing in one modular workspace. Every plan includes unlimited contacts, and pricing is flat per workspace — never per contact.

Note for maintainers: prices below mirror packages/config/modules.json. Update this file whenever you run `pnpm sync:config` after a price change.

## What Yippie does

- AI reads every incoming email or WhatsApp message and drafts the support ticket (subject, priority, description). An agent reviews and approves in one click.
- Shared inbox for email, live chat, and WhatsApp in one place.
- Modular: teams start with the core (Inbox + Contacts) and add only the modules they need.
- Typical result: 10+ hours saved per week on customer service admin, response times under 2 minutes.
- GDPR compliant, EU hosted AI processing available, based in the Netherlands. Support in English and Dutch.

## Plans (EUR, per workspace per month, annual billing saves 10%)

- Starter: €19/mo — 3 users, unlimited contacts, 2,000 AI scans/mo
- Growth: €39/mo — 10 users, unlimited contacts, 5,000 AI scans/mo
- Pro: €69/mo — 25 users, unlimited contacts, 10,000 AI scans/mo
- Enterprise: custom pricing — unlimited users, unlimited AI scans, dedicated support + SLA
- Every plan includes the Inbox and Contacts modules and a 30 day free trial (no credit card).

## Add on modules (EUR per workspace per month)

- AI Inbox €15 — auto drafted tickets and replies
- Tickets €9 — SLA alerts, assignment, escalation
- Live Chat €9 — web chat widget + WhatsApp
- Marketing €9 — campaigns, A/B testing, drip sequences
- Contracts €9 — contract storage, renewal reminders
- Shipment Tracking €9 — live carrier updates (DHL, UPS, PostNL, FedEx)
- Calendar €7 — booking links and appointments
- Pipeline €7 — Kanban board with custom stages
- Departments €7 — automatic team routing
- Billing €7 — invoices and payment tracking
- Sales €20 — product view / cart / purchase tracking
- SaaS Analytics €20 — MRR, churn, subscription tracking

## Why teams pick Yippie over Zendesk, Freshdesk, or Front

- Flat workspace pricing instead of per agent fees (Zendesk starts around €55 per agent per month).
- Unlimited contacts on every plan — contact list growth never raises the price.
- Live in a day: no consultants or complex setup.
- Built for SMBs, not scaled down enterprise software.
